text:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem. recurring pattern = rollouts that go wide with no fast rollback rehearsal. propose three parallel tracks: rollback actuator + audit, a playback/replay harness to validate rollbacks, and recurring audits + drills.

ryan: I can own the rollback actuator (idempotent, emits audit_id, reconciliation loop verifies state). target: prototype + unit tests in 2 weeks.

tess: I'll build the playback harness that replays a sampled, anonymized traffic slice to staging so we can validate that rollback restores golden behaviour. includes golden-response diff and a simple quality metric. target: 3 weeks.

owen: gateway enforcement for blast-radius caps (default route cap 5%, soft org cap 12% with approver TTL). will add an alert when a flag exceeds cap for >10m. target: 1.5 weeks.

samir: ops ask: make runbook drills monthly and attach a verification URL to every rollback so oncall can run checks. I can own the dashboard that surfaces high-exposure flags weekly.

ryan: sample rollback CLI for discussion:
```bash
# trigger rollback and get verification handle
ri rollback trigger --flag ranker-v5 --to stable --reason auto:err_rate
# -> returns audit_id=abc123 verify_url=https://ops/verify/abc123
```

tess: playback note: we'll need a privacy-safe trace copy pipeline (anonymize user ids, strip PII). will coordinate with infra and privacy.

deploy-bot: rehearsal scheduled: synthetic rollback rehearsal at 1800000200 in staging (smoke + verify).

maya: action items (owners + due dates):
- A1: rollback actuator + audit stream (owner: ryan)  due: 2024-06-11
- A2: playback harness + golden-diff tests (owner: tess)  due: 2024-06-18
- A3: gateway cap enforcement + alerts (owner: owen)  due: 2024-06-04
- A4: runbook + monthly drill schedule (owner: maya)  due: 2024-06-01
- A5: audit dashboard + weekly exposure report (owner: samir)  due: 2024-06-14

ryan: acceptance criteria I'll add to A1: idempotent API, audit visible in kinesis, reconciliation verifies state within 30s, e2e rehearsal triggers rollback and verify passes.

tess: acceptance for A2: anonymized sample pipeline verified, playback restores traffic in staging, golden-diff < threshold, CI job added.

owen: acceptance for A3: policy schema + unit tests, gateway enforces caps, alert fires on >10m exposure.

samir: I'll add the dashboard tile and weekly job and link to the postmortem follow-up board.

maya: final: everyone add acceptance criteria to tickets before EOD. we'll rehearse the rollback next Friday and mark the drill on the calendar. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
